title: Data Migration Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Data Migration Engineer for a public sector organisation based nationally (remote/hybrid) on an initial 6 months contract, paying up to £557 per day (Inside IR35).


This is a hybrid role with two days a week in the office and the occasional trip to a central hub or London if required.


The successful Data Migration Engineer will analyse large volumes of unstructured data and present complex information clearly. You'll run large-scale enterprise migrations from file shares to SharePoint Online, automate data preparation and post-migration activity, and handle validation and remediation. You'll also apply retention policies, maintain audit logs and produce data packs and analysis outputs.


You will need proven experience in the following:


Large-scale enterprise migration from file shares to SharePoint Online

Managing multiple concurrent migrations

PowerShell scripting

SharePoint Online and Power Automate

Working with unstructured data and large datasets

Data retention, classification and audit logging

Post-migration validation and remediation


Practical exposure to the following would be beneficial:


NetApp BlueXP

ShareGate

Microsoft 365 and Azure

Linux


You'll need to hold or be eligible to obtain SC clearance for this role.


Interested?


Please apply below.


Data Migration Engineer, Data and Migration Analyst, SharePoint Online, PowerShell, Power Automate, ShareGate, NetApp BlueXP, M365, Azure, data migration, London, Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Hybrid/Remote, Contract, Inside IR35


Invitise is an ISO 9001 certified supplier to UK public sector frameworks, recruiting across technical and non-technical roles alongside our cyber security specialism.
